description: This Java source file defines the DashboardWebSocketHandler class, which manages WebSocket connections for a dashboard in the MockServer project. It handles WebSocket upgrades, message processing, and updates to connected clients based on server logs and request matchers.

classes.name: DashboardWebSocketHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication for the MockServer dashboard, including connection upgrades, message handling, and client updates based on server logs and request matchers.

methods.name: handlerAdded
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler thread pool when a channel handler is added.

methods.name: handlerRemoved
methods.description: Shuts down thread pools when the handler is removed.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, handling WebSocket upgrade requests and WebSocket frames.

methods.name: channelReadComplete
methods.description: Flushes the channel after read completion.

methods.name: upgradeChannel
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake and upgrades the HTTP connection.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Initializes serializers, loggers, and registers listeners for server logs and request matchers.

methods.name: handleWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Handles different WebSocket frame types such as close, text, ping, and unsupported frames.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the WebSocket client, with retry logic if the semaphore is unavailable.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Logs and closes the connection on exceptions.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Unregisters listeners when the channel becomes inactive.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Updates clients with new log entries or request matcher changes.

methods.name: sendUpdate
methods.description: Prepares and sends an update message to clients based on server logs and request matchers.
